pgroonga.index: CREATE INDEX candidate_lexical ON candidate_sections USING pgroonga (index_text) WITH (tokenizer='TokenBigram', normalizers='NormalizerAuto')
pgroonga.query: SELECT source_id, pgroonga_score(tableoid,ctid)::double precision AS score FROM candidate_sections WHERE index_text &@~ $1 ORDER BY score DESC, source_id COLLATE "C" ASC LIMIT 20
pgroonga.ranking: PGroonga default term frequency, not BM25

pg_search.analyzer: pdb.chinese_compatible with default filters; no external dictionary
pg_search.index: CREATE INDEX candidate_lexical ON candidate_sections USING bm25 (source_id, (index_text::pdb.chinese_compatible)) WITH (key_field='source_id')
pg_search.query: SELECT source_id, paradedb.score(source_id)::double precision AS score FROM candidate_sections WHERE source_id @@@ paradedb.match('index_text', $1, conjunction_mode=>false) ORDER BY score DESC, source_id COLLATE "C" ASC LIMIT 20
pg_search.ranking: pg_search BM25; match tokenizer uses index configuration, disjunction mode, no fuzzy/prefix

measurements: Index relation bytes only; no latency or indexing time comparison because these runners use container-owned unix sockets through psql, unlike historical TLS/pgx client timing.

dense.formula: sum(1/(60+rank)); absent leg contributes 0; source_id ASCII tie
